recordingProfileCapture.artifactIntegrity: all 15 implementation images and 15 measurement records matched manifest byte counts and SHA-256 values
recordingProfileCapture.note: The Nx capture target ran both the app and E2E typecheck prerequisites before completing all 15 states. Every state required a real recording-desktop full-motion WebGL canvas, seed 43117, render readiness, no observed context loss, and an observed screen-composition measurement. All 13 source-applicable copy states, all 12 source-applicable route states, all 7 source-observed landmark states, all 5 source-applicable field states, the independent field-contact center, and journey-exit additionally carry structural evidence records. The two transition-copy states use state-specific visible-ink regions and never infer censored pixels. The source contract uses composition as the primary structure for landing and landing-idle, and field profile as the primary structure for field-approach and field-pulse-a; all 15 source-primary structures are observed. The four corresponding landmark fields remain honestly blocked secondary annotations. Three implementation field profiles are observed while preview and approach fail the unchanged source-pixel quality gate. Three transferable landmarks and all 12 applicable routes are observed; the reveal and landing-idle packet is now decoupled from activation feeder geometry, and eight cyan-family states use renderer-independent localhost classifiers. Four source-mask landmarks, including the complete arrival arrow, are compared with renderer-independent implementation masks; source masks remain reference-only and never classify implementation pixels. Runtime errors, context loss, invalid structural records, and missing composition evidence are hard failures, and the complete size/SHA-256 manifest is published atomically.

currentLiveProfileProbe.qualification: Tablet and mobile are browser emulations, not physical-device or performance evidence. Main-thread context-loss events were monitored; worker and OffscreenCanvas context-loss state remains unknown.

fieldTileProfileEvidence.qualification: The same bright-neutral predicate and component-shape gates measure full visible tile tops in both rasters. Clipped, activated, pulse-recolored, and bloom-obscured tiles are not inferred. Preview and approach are blocked because the implementation has no qualifying field components in the source-defined ROIs.

fieldContactCenterEvidence.qualification: The shared chroma predicate measures only the saturated field-contact center tile. It is independent structural evidence and does not replace the authoritative source-tied tile-plus-standing-figure semantic landmark union.

landmarkEvidence.qualification: Loader, world-reveal, and field-pulse-b use shared transferable chroma masks. Activation-route, activation-contact, field-contact, and arrival-lockup use hash-locked source semantic masks paired with separate renderer-independent localhost classifiers. All seven comparisons are true filled-silhouette evidence and fail the locked minimum.

routeEvidence.qualification: The centerline metric is exact symmetric Euclidean Hausdorff distance over deterministic skeletons of the visible selected route-core masks. It includes parallel rails and branches without inferring a hidden renderer spline.

comparison.reason: The whole four-row landing/journey DOM ladder passes all 13 applicable state contracts; loader-mark and world-reveal have no applicable DOM profile. The unmasked full-frame raster is only a preliminary diagnostic and passes 1 of 15 states. Shared source/implementation algorithms measure all 15 composition records, all 13 source-applicable copy envelopes, all 12 source-applicable route states, three transferable landmark states, all five source-applicable field tile profiles, the independent field-contact center tile, and the journey-exit boundary; four source-mask landmarks carry separate renderer-independent implementation-mask comparisons. The source masks remain reference-only. Composition passes 190/285 checks, copy bounds pass 21/52, field evidence passes 8/27, contact-center evidence passes 0/5, landmark evidence passes 14/35, all 12 observed route cores pass 16/84, and the boundary passes 4/4. Preview and approach field profiles are the only implementation quality blocks. All seven landmark silhouettes are measured failures: loader 0.3987, world reveal 0.6460, activation route 0.7009, activation contact 0.6498, field contact 0.1878, field pulse B 0.3548, and arrival lockup 0.3642. The arrival value is true filled-silhouette evidence, not the retired Sobel edge proxy. Structural accuracy is 0 pass / 13 fail / 2 blocked. Neither preliminary raster, partial geometry success, nor DOM success confers final visual acceptance.

blockingEvidence.issue: Deterministic recording measurement resolves 7 landmarks, 12 visible route cores, 13 copy-ink envelopes, 5 field tile profiles, 1 independent saturated field-contact center tile, 15 fixed-grid screen-space composition proxies, and 1 section boundary. All 15 source-primary structures and all 13 applicable copy states are observed. Shared renderer-independent algorithms measure all implementation composition, copy, route, field, contact-center, and boundary roles; three transferable landmark states use shared predicates, while four source-mask landmarks use separate renderer-independent localhost classifiers. The source masks remain hash-locked, reference-only refinement evidence and cannot classify implementation pixels or confer acceptance. Composition passes 190/285 checks, copy bounds 21/52, field evidence 8/27, contact center 0/5, landmarks 14/35, routes 16/84, and boundary bounds 4/4. Preview and approach field profiles are the only implementation quality blocks. All seven landmark silhouette IoUs are measured failures: loader 0.3987, world reveal 0.6460, activation route 0.7009, activation contact 0.6498, field contact 0.1878, field pulse B 0.3548, and arrival lockup 0.3642. Arrival is no longer blocked, and the obsolete Sobel edge-support proxy has been removed. All 12 visible-core route centerline Hausdorff distances fail the 0.75% short-edge maximum, ranging from 9.7675% to 93.9334%. Structural accuracy is 0 pass / 13 fail / 2 blocked. Pointer and route-envelope observables remain potential Phase 1 additions, but no currently declared source-primary role is missing. The current implementation passes all 13 applicable live DOM contracts; DOM success does not substitute for structural or final visual acceptance.
The procedural world, route projection, static cameras, materials, lighting, effects, and geometry have not passed state-specific structural and visual tolerances.
Loader, landing packets, field pulse cadence, pointer-trail appearance, and arrival timing remain comparison candidates rather than accepted source matches.

The Phase 19 acceptance performance run remains unrun on locked hardware. An earlier development software-renderer diagnostic exceeded frame-time, long-task, and mobile CLS budgets and is not acceptance evidence.

acceptance.reason: The current architecture, deterministic controls, repeat capture, genuine desktop/mobile convergence matrix, and manifest integrity pass their local Phase 5 gate. Ordered acceptance remains held at Phase 1. All 15 source-primary structures and all 13 applicable copy states are observed. Shared algorithms measure all 15 composition records, all 13 copy envelopes, all 12 routes, three transferable landmarks, all five field profiles, the independent field-contact center tile, and both journey-exit boundaries; four hash-locked source semantic masks are paired only with separate renderer-independent localhost classifiers. Landmark evidence now passes 14/35 checks, and arrival lockup is a measured 0.3642 silhouette mismatch rather than an edge-only block. Preview and approach field profiles are the only two structurally blocked states. The comparator reports 1/15 preliminary raster states passing and structural accuracy at 0 pass / 13 fail / 2 blocked, despite a 13/13 applicable whole-ladder DOM pass; final hero acceptance is therefore blocked.
